newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firm in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firm in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer in after-hours trade on Monday, lifted by short-covering as the yen turned lower against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 1.1 yen per kg firmer than the day's close. The most-active benchmark July contract was up 0.8 yen at 158.7 yen. Volume was 9,079 lots.
The market opened weaker across the board, as private investors took profits following price rallies last week.
"Market sentiment has improved. If China steps up to buy Thai rubber after Chinese new year, prices here are expected to edge up," one trader said.
